title: Bridging Neural Representations and Symbolic Semantics in Audio Classification
summary: The first version of the paper shows a learned audio-classifier and symbolic-induction result on held-out acoustic associations. The result is reported in the arXiv preprint. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: Learned classifier activations define response sets and symbolic induction produces acoustic tag combinations.
